<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Srinagar seat vacancy:</strong> The Lok Sabha Speaker has officially accepted the resignation of Aga Ruhullah, leaving the Srinagar parliamentary constituency vacant.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxNMW5SR18xOVpIaTdfWV9yM3JQM25iZ3FiNTVHaUJnMEdoMEh4U0lGTGM4Q0NrVDFIWDB1Wll0SXVBUjBlTUxmMU0wc3JvbkJBZDBxeElVVnJRb2FZalYtNlhBYmkxak5fMFBJWUpTUEZKRXB4aUFuLUpKYnY4OXl6Tjg0amxNeFc5SFp2Z0RKZVZUWENfdFVzYUszYUlKV3Fac1M0VWVNMF8?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Voter list controversy:</strong> The Election Commission has opened a window for excluded electors to update voter lists in seven states, sparking a heated political exchange between the BJP and Congress regarding the integrity of the process.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>UGC equity review:</strong> The Centre informed the Supreme Court that it intends to establish a committee to review UGC equity regulations following concerns regarding student protection.</li>
  <li><strong>National Book Trust status:</strong> The Supreme Court has ruled that the National Book Trust qualifies as &#x27;State&#x27; under Article 12, confirming it is subject to government-control tests.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>ECI administrative oversight:</strong> Following internal restructuring, the Election Commission has reaffirmed its oversight of the IT department, placing the IT chief under a Senior Deputy Election Commissioner.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
</ul>
